method.profile: make_speed_profile: points every 0.5 m of station; path curvature from the reference's curvature and rate and the offset's derivatives; slopes vary linearly between segment middles, the car's own slope over start_turn_m; caps from the plan's limits (grip fractions, or envelope_fraction of the car's lateral/forward/braking limits); backward pass from the end speed, forward pass from the car's actual speed; time as constant acceleration between end speeds along the path's own distance
method.path_as_driven: from the car straight to the path's first point at least a pursuit distance ahead, then along its points; the reference line rejoins the reference a pursuit distance ahead
method.horizon: the end of the decision's farthest path, at least 60 m, ending no faster than the reference plan there
method.choice: the clear option of least estimated time, the cheaper path on a tie; the previous decision's choice kept while clear and within lattice_switch_margin_s = 0.05 s of the fastest
method.search_changes: a turn is refused only if beyond the lateral budget at the slowest speed the car can brake to by then; within a pursuit distance of the car a blockage is widened by the half width only; a return continues whatever path the car was on
method.controller: ControlIntent::speed_profile: target interpolated in speed squared, feedforward the span's acceleration; before the profile its first speed, beyond it the reference plan

fd_speed_profile: a straight at the top speed holds it: 60 m in 3 s, samples every half metre
from rest the speed is the square root of twice the longitudinal grip fraction times distance, and the time its square root law
inside the first corner the cap is the circle's: on the reference sqrt(lateral*18), 2 m inside or outside sqrt(lateral*16) and sqrt(lateral*20), with lengths scaled by the same ratio
braking into the corner follows the backward pass exactly, over more than 40 samples
the profile ends no faster than asked
a start beyond the path's limit brakes at the limit until within, and says so
a 2 m step over 10 m turns at the segments' middles: curvature 0.02/(1+slope^2)^1.5, path longer than its stations by its slope, and the turn caps the speed
along the reference the profile reproduces the plan's curvature limits, with the grip fractions and with the four-wheel car's envelope (34 points each)
the controller follows a profile, and the reference plan beyond it, command for command
fd_lattice_planning: the faster side is passed when both are clear: on the straight the right path is cheaper and faster; before the first corner the inside (left) costs 2.16e6 against 1.18e6 but is 0.078 s faster and is taken
a near tie keeps the previous choice; a difference beyond the margin switches
each action is predicted along its own speed profile, to a common horizon, with its time equal to that profile's
the estimate is what the car drives: the first pass decision estimated 3.210 s to its horizon and the car took 3.25 s
a pass is finished before returning: the four-wheel car on 80% of its envelope passes the corner blockage 3.67 m off, no sample outside the corridor, worst rear sideslip 0.064 rad
the closed-loop scenarios still avoid and stop, and the lattice planner's pass uses less grip than the five-offset planner's
no clear way home keeps the path the car is on: with grip dropped to 0.45 beside the lane blockage, 220 decisions find nothing clear and every one keeps the lattice path, saying so
fd_recording_playback: a schema 11 run of each planner round-trips, decision for decision, including the run that loses every clear way home

seven tampered variants are rejected by name: a profile not starting at the recorded state, an estimated time disagreeing with its profile, a lattice path without a profile, profiles of one decision ending at different stations, a choice that was neither the fastest clear action nor the previous one within the margin, a blocked line taken while a clear one was offered, and a decision that drove on past the blockage it named with nothing clear
